item.tib: rig 'dzin kun grol grags pas mdzad pa'i tshogs 'bring po 'bul lugs
item.coloph: ces pa zhi khro bar do thos grol gyi tshogs rgyas pa rkang thon dang 'bring po tshom bu ma'i 'bul lugs 'di ni/ gzhung las kha 'phongs yod pa ltar/ rtogs ltan shes rab tshul khrims kyis bsgrigs pa/ rjes su rig 'dzin kun grol grags pa nyid kyi dag ther mdzad pa yin pas yid ches mdzad pa'o//
